organization.name: Alex Tselegidis / AT Software Development Agency
organization.notes: Official anniversary history dates initial Google Code publication to 2013; 2014 stable-release anniversary is distinct. Current agency site verifies commercial stewardship by Alex and his team, but no legal incorporation year or equity funding history established. Public funding/sponsor searches did not establish investors; unknown is not bootstrap classification.

pricingTiers.name: Easy!Appointments
pricingTiers.notes: GPL core is free; infrastructure and optional premium services separate.
No explicitly highlighted Most popular or Recommended plan found in the public pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Premium custom development / managed hosting
pricingTiers.notes: Closest explicitly business service offer; formal custom-development quote and quote form. Not a separate packaged feature edition.

pricingTiers.name: Extended License / enterprise-grade managed hosting
pricingTiers.notes: White-label Extended License for SaaS providers/resellers and enterprise-grade managed hosting are quoted services; no published recurring Enterprise software tier.

moats.claim: A mature appointment, customer and provider data model plus accumulated scheduling configuration can create moderate switching costs; GPL availability limits exclusivity.

productReasons.claim: Separate service and provider schedules model employee availability, breaks and booking rules.
Group sessions allow several customers to reserve places within one appointment slot.
Google and CalDAV synchronization connect bookable availability to external calendars.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate sponsorship established in the checked project/business pages; commercial steward included as business fallback.

requirements.notes: Stable require block lists curl, JSON, mbstring, gd, simplexml and fileinfo; bundled PHP libraries are not external services.
Production web server; older installation article has stale PHP minimum, superseded by stable composer manifest.

requirements.condition: Production relational data store; official Docker example uses MySQL 8.0.
When notification email enabled; default PHP mail transport.
Building from development checkout only; not extra production services for a prepared release.

resources.notes: No numerical hardware minima verified in the cited deployment documentation.

selfHosting.notes: Production PHP/web-server/MySQL route; official container image bundles application runtime and uses a separate MySQL service. No mandatory Redis, queue broker or search engine documented. Email delivery transport needed only when enabling notifications. Release 1.6.1 PHP floor takes precedence over stale generic installation page.

options.name: Softaculous automated installation
options.notes: Official project guide links provider installer; target URL failed tool access, so official deployment guide is used as allowed actionable deployment URL. Current provider search result lists 1.6.0 while project stable is 1.6.1; check version before deployment.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official automated Softaculous deployment documented. Linked target www.softaculous.com/softaculous/apps/others/EasyAppointments inaccessible in fetch; provider search result confirms current listing but one release behind. Manual web wizard and Compose are separate routes.
